context: Answer to the Layer 2 result-storage key choice raised by LAYER2-BUILD-3's read-only measurement (docs/reports/2026-10-21-layer2-build-plan.md §9): option A = one cell_id per lot (~110,223 cells, ~5.84M rows, ~2.4 GB, over the 10% kill line); option B = key each target's result by that target's own read inputs (~300,463 rows, ~0.13 GB, 19x fewer). Also: operator uploaded new Scarborough and Toronto CoA data to Drive COA_PLANS_MAXBLD to close coverage gaps.

decisions.subject: Layer 2 result storage key
decisions.recommendation: Option B: key each target's stored result by the values of that target's own read inputs (shared across lots with the same inputs), not one cell_id per lot. Amends the Layer 2 key row (cell_id) and the Spec 134 §3 row shape before commit ① freezes it.
